description: DiligenceOps: submit a changelog or release notes (text, or a public HTTPS url) with an optional claimed_version. The signed report lists each entry with its version and date, says whether the claimed version has an entry of its own, is only mentioned or is absent, and flags duplicate versions, versions out of listing order, a higher version dated before a lower one, dates after the check date and unreadable dates, each quoted with its offset. POST /api/changelog-check. Reads the supplied text, or one public HTTPS page read once with GET (no redirects, public DNS only, 512 KB): no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of text or url.

claimed_version.description: Optional version to look for, for example "2.4.0" or "v2.4".

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

text.description: The changelog or release notes as plain text, Markdown or HTML, up to 256 KB.

url.description: A public HTTPS changelog or release notes page, read once with GET, no redirects, up to 512 KB.

name: wever_changelog-check
title: Changelog check
